mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyNotes drops the structural prohibition against mutating clinical notes; the injected fact then forces a note whose noteModified=BTrue, which the AppendOnly and FR_011 predicates explicitly forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NotesEdited { some n: ClinicalNote | n.noteModified = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAudit removes audit-entry immutability; the injection forces an audit entry with aeModified=BTrue, violating the append-only / retention invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditEdited { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeModified = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OneAuditPerOperation lets the model invent an operation without a matching audit entry; the injection forces exactly such an orphan, which AuditCompleteness rejects.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanOp { some o: Operation | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeFor = o }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamGating removes the requirement that a permitted clinical access be backed by an active care-team membership; the injection forces a Permitted RecordLookup with no such membership, which OwnershipBasedAccess catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareTeam { some o: Operation | o.opKind = RecordLookup and o.opOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctmClinician = o.opCaller and m.ctmPatient = o.opTargetPatient and m.ctmActive = BTrue) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AdminContentBlind removes the rule that admin responses carry no clinical content; the injection forces an operation by a hospital_administrator that returns clinical content, breaking FR-005 and FR-018.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminLeak { some o: Operation | o.opCaller.role = HospitalAdministrator and o.opReturnedClinicalContent = BTrue }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditFieldsMatch allows the audit-entry user/role snapshot to drift from the underlying operation; the injection forces an audit entry whose recorded user differs from the operation's actual caller, which AttributionCorrectness catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadAttribution { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeUserSnap != ae.aeFor.opCaller }
